buyer.name: Sahyadri Consumer Products Pvt. Ltd.
buyer.industry: FMCG – foods, beverages, home & personal care

event.title: Annual Rate Contract – Corrugated Packaging (FY 2026-27 H2 to FY 2027-28 H1)

evaluation_fx.basis: Fixed evaluation rate set in RFx (SCPL treasury rate on issue date). Applied to any non-INR quote for comparison only.

event.normalization_basis: INR per piece (or per set for partitions), ex-GST, delivered to the specified SCPL plant (FOR destination)

plants.name: Bengaluru Plant
plants.address: Plot 41-B, KIADB Hoskote Industrial Area, Bengaluru Rural, Karnataka 562114

plants.name: Pune Plant
plants.address: Gat No. 318, Chakan MIDC Phase II, Pune, Maharashtra 410501

scope.partial_bids: Allowed. Vendors may quote a subset of lines; unquoted lines must be marked 'Not quoted'.

requirements.requirement: Deliver to the plant specified per line (BLR / PNQ / HYD) as per weekly call-off schedule.
Annual quantities in rfx_master are estimates (+/-20%); no take-or-pay commitment.
Lead time from PO <= 14 days for repeat items; <= 21 days for first supply of new artwork / tooling.
Meet or exceed the per-line board construction, BF, bursting strength and recycled-content minimums. Moisture content 7-9% at dispatch.
COA with every lot (GSM, BS, ECT/BCT, moisture; Cobb for coated lines). SCPL incoming AQL 2.5 (General II) on dimensions and print.
Lines CP-012 and CP-029 require water-resistant coating meeting the Cobb value in rfx_master. Uncoated offers are non-compliant.
ISO 9001:2015 certification of supplying plant(s).
FSC Chain-of-Custody certification.
BRCGS Packaging / ISO 22000 for lines used in food categories.
Prices FOR SCPL delivery plant (freight included). Where freight is excluded or 'at actuals', SCPL applies a 5% evaluation loading on the unit price for comparison.
Quote exclusive of GST; state GST rate and HSN separately. Evaluation is ex-GST (input credit available).
Quote in INR. Non-INR quotes are accepted but converted at the fixed evaluation FX rate (1 USD = INR 88.50) for comparison; FX risk sits with the vendor in the contract.
SCPL standard: 60 days from GRN. Minimum acceptable 45 days; shorter terms are a commercial deviation.
Prices firm for 180 days from quotation date. Minimum acceptable 90 days; shorter validity is a commercial deviation.
MOQ per line should not exceed one month's call-off quantity (annual / 12).
State one-time printing plate / cutting-die costs explicitly; tooling becomes SCPL property.
Bundles of 25/50 strapped, palletised and stretch-wrapped; no warp > 5 mm; print registration +/- 1 mm; Pantone match per approved shade card.
OTIF >= 95% measured monthly; complaint acknowledgement within 24 h and CAPA within 7 days.
Score >= 70/100 on the technical questionnaire AND full compliance on all mandatory questions.
Any kraft-paper price variation clause must reference a published index (e.g., monthly kraft paper index) with a defined trigger and formula.

evaluation.comparison_basis: INR per piece (or per set for partitions), ex-GST, delivered to the specified SCPL plant (FOR destination)
evaluation.landed_price_formula: normalized_unit_price_inr + freight (quoted, or 5% loading where excluded)
evaluation.award_strategy: Line-wise or plant-wise award possible; maximum 3 vendors overall.
